production.direction_en: Vespera’s glass lantern reveals three hidden anchors around the conservatory. Thistle and Iona, who followed the same message up from the Undercity, set up a field infirmary beneath a stone arch.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch6_estate with glass harmonics (Vespera's lantern) | post: bgm_revelation (soft)

commands.speaker: vespera_wisp
commands.text: This ward is drinking time from the glass. Slowly. Patiently.

commands.speaker: vespera_wisp
commands.text: I saw this ward beneath the city, in the Guild's lowest cistern. I left before I understood what it was drinking.

commands.speaker: thistle_roe
commands.text: Then we will stop it before it drinks from anyone else.

commands.speaker: iona_mist
commands.text: Break the anchors or let Vespera unwind the seal. Either path is safe.
